_comment: The player hero (cooks/hero.md, cooks/build-hero-anim.md): the MetaHuman male (m) and female (f) picked in the main menu (?Body= on the join URL), built from these parts by AWRCharacter::LoadBodyArt. One set of clips serves both (retargeted once onto the male body; UWRHeroAnimInstance fits them to the female's proportions). Locomotion is motion matching over the GASP 5.8 databases in mmDir, picked by the 'locomotion' chooser; everything else (swings, casts, rolls, hits, deaths, gathering, block and aim loops) is one-shots and loops by key, as before.

m._name: M1 Ash, athletic build, Survivor Wraps
m._faces: faces[0] is the default (no ?Look=). Each: head, its skin for every build (bodyMaterial), default grooms (engine plugin grooms + a binding to this head), hair colour, creator thumbnail, every groom option of this sex.

f._name: F1 Wren, athletic build, Survivor Wraps
f._faces: faces[0] is the default (no ?Look=). Each: head, its skin for every build (bodyMaterial), default grooms (engine plugin grooms + a binding to this head), hair colour, creator thumbnail, every groom option of this sex.

_sockets: Sockets on every hero body (made in the lab, hero.md 3.1 L5). Hand sockets: X through the fist out past the index finger, Z out of the palm, origin in the palm. shield_l: X down the forearm, Z out of the back of the arm.
_layers: One-shots play from upperBody up (the legs keep their locomotion) unless listed in fullBody. spineBones share the twist that keeps the chest on the facing while the legs stand (turn in place); legBones plant the feet on slopes.
_locomotion: The motion-matching chooser: the first row whose state (idle / moving / air / land / swim), gait (walk / run / sprint) and stance (melee / ranged / bow_aim / rifle_aim / block) match wins; its databases are searched together. Gaits: walk below anim.mm.walkBelow cm/s of top speed (aiming, blocking), sprint at player.sprintSpeed, run between. 'fallback' is for other players' heroes at LOD anim.mm.fallbackLOD and beyond (cheap loops only).
_looks: cook hero-look-2: the worn armour picks a look (armorLooks); 4 visual slots per build; hide = body-hide masks (skin under the piece is clipped); hidesHair = the Head piece hides the hair groom; materials = slot-name swaps.
_armorLooks: item id -> look. The steel biome set items and their starsteel (Ascendant, tier 6) versions arrive with the crafting cook under these ids.
_paths: hero.md 2.6 path marks. skin: MF_PathMarks params (Main*/Sub* prefixed by the code). eye/eyeSub/hair: the MetaHuman eye and hair material params, blended from the materials own value by the path strength (sub path at 0.6 x, eyeSub at half of that). pulseSeconds: the flare on each ability use. caninesFrom: Blood fangs from that strength.
